title: Shiloh's songs
description: Add some discs featuring songs by Shiloh Dynasty into Minecraft.
body:
# Add some discs featuring songs by Shiloh Dynasty into Minecraft.

## Tatses Like Velvet
I used 5 songs from the album: [Tastes Like Velvet](https://www.youtube.com/@ShilohDynasty.)

It has special textures like this.

![Tastes Like Velvet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/012b07e8e78a4f762d540598ae8a1c97826459bb.png)


## Poison Tree textures
XXXTENTACION used 3 songs sampled by Shiloh Dynasty, in this mod it's called: _Drunk and confused, I know you're somewhere_ and _Nighmares._ I draw a symbol _Poison Tree_ which is a tattoo that XXXTENTACION had in his forehead to remember this legend collab.

![XXXTENTACION](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af85d1e01f793eadc4d50a903063a9efe6a434f4.png)

## The remaining discs
And the remaining discs are the songs from her old clips, I just add short versions for these discs.

![The remaining discs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c60351ea3ba4d09b6a44146a461a80987e34338.png)
